descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S10 Empty list to one patient and back to empty, live on the other device

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Fresh physician with no Hospital patient (the resident only); phone on the empty Hospital list

When Computer adds 'QA Sync Only', then removes it (confirm once)

Then The phone's empty list becomes a list with that one card, then returns to the empty state with a way to add patients. It is never blank and never needs a refresh

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain 'QA Sync Only'; cp2 mustNotContain 'QA Sync Only' and mustContain 'Morning Rounds' (used only to show the list page rendered, not blank; the empty-state wording is judged in the Empty & Failure States matrix); both forbid 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong'; no-reload proof from the session log

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)
